newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Governor to award $56 mln in local grants.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Governor to award $56 mln in local grants.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson said Wednesday that the state would award more than $56 million to local agencies and organizations to fund teen education programs and enhance mentoring services.
Community Challenge Grants, totaling $53.6 million, will be used to fund local programs working to prevent teen and unwed pregnancy, Wilson said.
In addition, Wilson said $2.5 million in mentoring funds would be awarded to 37 organizations and counties statewide.
The awards will become effective on February 1 and will run through June 1999, Wilson, a Republican, said.
